verdict.rationale: The pack never documents actual serverless rate-limit values or how they scale across usage or spend tiers. The closest items are adjacent: on-demand deployments are described as having "no hard rate limits", the Priority service tier is about load-shedding priority rather than quota tiers, reserved throughput is a purchase option, and monthly spend limits are a billing cap. None of these lets a developer read the limits before hitting them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production
